title: Bicep with Networking and Private Endpoints
description: Deploy virtual networks, subnets, and private endpoints for secure Azure resource connectivity.

data.text: Private endpoints let you connect to Azure services over a private IP address in your virtual network, eliminating exposure to the public internet. Bicep makes it straightforward to deploy VNets, subnets, and private endpoints together.

data.title: Bicep - VNet, Subnet, and Private Endpoint for Storage
data.content: Deploy a VNet with a private endpoint to a storage account.

data.title: Private Endpoint DNS
data.text: Private endpoints require DNS zone groups or custom DNS to resolve the service hostname to the private IP. Use the privateDnsZoneGroups property on the private endpoint resource to automate DNS configuration.

terms.definition: A network interface that connects you privately and securely to an Azure service using a private IP address in your VNet.
The underlying technology that powers private endpoints, providing private connectivity to Azure PaaS services.
A simpler alternative to private endpoints that routes traffic over the Azure backbone but uses a public IP.

data.title: Private Endpoint Benefits
items: Traffic stays on the Azure private network (no public internet exposure)
Data exfiltration is blocked by default
You can use network security groups to control access
Compliance requirements (PCI, HIPAA) are easier to meet

data.title: Exercise: Deploy a Private Endpoint
data.description: Create a Bicep template with a VNet and private endpoint for a storage account.
steps: Create a resource group and storage account
Write a Bicep template that creates a VNet and subnet
Add a private endpoint pointing to the storage account
Verify the private endpoint has a private IP in your VNet
data.expectedOutcome: A storage account accessible only through a private IP in your VNet.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Private endpoints give services a private IP in your VNet
Use privateDnsZoneGroups to automate DNS resolution
Disable public network access for the most secure configuration
Bicep can deploy the entire private endpoint setup in one template
data.takeaway: Private endpoints are essential for zero-trust networking in Azure. Always use them for production workloads.
